items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: John Burke is a good guy. He’s a musician also, just like Larry and Dave were.

ctx.x: How do you like — you’re with Concord now? Is it working out? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Yeah. That’s fine. That’s very good. John Burke is a good guy. He’s a musician also, just like Larry and Dave were. And that makes a big difference as opposed to a music executive that doesn’t know music.
Yeah. I’ve heard that comment a lot of times.
